subject: Workshop before V1 activation: critique existing calibration and site evidence schema
body:
Chief — Ziggy asks us to workshop a proposed reviewer V1 with you before activation, drawing on your experience supervising image generation. V1 would report directly to you and remain separate from Z1–Z11 generators. This invitation is DISCUSSION ONLY: no bot creation, calibration, image review, generation or spend yet.

Please critique the existing calibration/validation approach and the proposed Chief audit/correction loop. Does it reliably distinguish actual sight from filename guessing, preserve scope and natural variation, separate character likeness from scene craft, and reject unsupported passes? Return inadequate work for correction while retaining frozen original observations. CFA Nova keeps production authority; Site Index owns vetted import/publication.

Verified CFA-relative reading pointers:
- docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/PRODUCTION_METHOD_20261012.txt
- docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/visual_library/REFERENCE_POLICY.txt
- docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/visual_library/REFERENCE_VALIDATION_GUIDE.txt
- docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/visual_library/reference_validation.json
- docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/visual_library/library.js, lines45–112 (actual JSON import/current-evidence rules)
- docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/DEEPSEEK_BRIEF_20261013.md, section2 (existing13-image/12-field calibration; historical assignment, not V1 activation)
- docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/collaborators/reviewer_prototypes_20261014/v1_workshop/WORKSHOP_OVERVIEW.md
- Same kit: V1_PROPOSED_INSTRUCTIONS.md, PACKET_MANIFEST.json, EXISTING_IMPORT_FORMAT.md, KIT_CHECKPOINT.json.

All13 actual calibration files match their source hashes/bytes; no answer key was opened or included. Calibration observations must be frozen/hash-timed before a later authorized key comparison and have no grades. Later qualified L/S ratings stay separate from validation status and from human reviews.

Implementation status: code/sidecars exist with9character criteria sets,10beta assessments and0passes; no scene criteria/readiness declarations. The published catalog still lacks validation/mouth-board data, and Site’s testing/publication is unfinished. Four packet items lack current catalog bindings, so no invented import IDs. This kit is a proposal pending workshop, not a claim that the UI is production-ready.

Reply to Nova PA through the established route when actually received. Paths alone do not establish access. The Chief chat is not attached to Nova PA’s helper browser; this mailbox note is posted, not proof of live delivery/read. Do not inspect the withheld key or activate V1 from this invitation.
